rationale.A: ~730 m mixed traffic on tram streets (Asemapäällikönkatu, Ratamestarinkatu, Kumpulantie), then path beside Teollisuuskatu; 7 lights
rationale.B: Same corridor on the path beside Teollisuuskatu (50 km/h); no traffic; unsignalised crossings; 7 lights
rationale.C: Paths beside Aleksis Kiven katu and Teollisuuskatu; unsignalised Sturenkatu; 7 lights
rationale.D: Vallila valley park path, Jyrängöntie, then path beside Hermannin rantatie; no traffic, no unsignalised crossings; 5 lights; +2 min
rationale.E: 410 m in traffic on Aleksis Kiven katu (250 m tram); 7 lights
rationale.F: Same as D, with a longer stretch beside Hermannin rantatie; 7 lights
rationale.G: Quiet Vallila wooden-house streets, but 260 m on Elimäenkatu and path beside Teollisuuskatu; 5 lights
rationale.H: Vallila valley and Kangasalantie, but an unsignalised Hämeentie crossing; 4 lights; +4 min

notes: A and B differ only by about a block over 600 m, so they count as the same route by geometry, though B avoids A's tram-street traffic. D at +2 min removes that traffic, adds park path and saves 2 lights.
